reader_aggregation: Each reader's 12-lead dwell-time vector normalised separately, then readers averaged equally.
PTBXL_evaluation: 5-fold OOF logistic-regression probing; patient-grouped where patient_id available
LUDB_evaluation: 5-fold OOF logistic-regression probing using dedicated metadata columns
pseudo_signal_method: Per-lead 3x4 image crop; row/column background suppression; vertical centre-of-mass of residual dark trace; interpolation; Savitzky-Golay smoothing; per-lead z-normalisation.
